Maya S: OrionPay wants a 2-week POC to replace VendorX's API. Key asks: prompt parity, response formatting, and enterprise SSO/KMS. Can we be near drop-in?
Alex P: Mostly yes. Caveats: tokenization differences (billing), sampling defaults causing output drift, and streaming framing mismatch.
Maya S: Need concrete items for the SOW.
Alex P: Actionable list: 1) deploy a small shim proxy to normalize tokenization and streaming frames; 2) lock sampling params in the shim for deterministic tests; 3) run A/B evals with a 10-prompt canonical set.
Devon R: Security: they require BYOK (Azure Key Vault) and Azure AD SSO. Our Private supports KMS + SAML/OIDC, but POC infra will need IP allowlist and audit log export to their SIEM.
Jordan L: Pricing: estimate 100k tokens/day for 14 days. Options: hosted prepaid credits or a short Dedicated burst commit for perf testing. Which do we recommend?
Priya K: Recommend hosted prepaid credits plus optional Dedicated burst for tail-latency testing. Keeps their commitment low while enabling SLA verification.
Maya S: Legal asked about data retention and audit logs. Devon, can we enable tenant-scoped logs and retention controls?
Devon R: Yes. We can enable per-tenant audit exports (S3/Syslog) and configurable retention during the POC. Webhooks will be HMAC-signed; we'll need their collector IPs.
Alex P: Example shim pseudo: POST /vendorx/generate -> POST /redwood/v1/generate; normalize prompt tokens; set sampling to temp=0.0 for determinism; translate streaming frames to VendorX's `data:` lines.
Jordan L: Call out token normalization in SOW to avoid billing disputes. Also include a fallthrough clause for model-variant cost deltas (quantized vs full).
Priya K: Deliverables: shim repo, setup guide, eval harness (10 prompts + scorer), SSO/KMS runbook, and cost model doc. I'll own the repo.
SecBot: Security questionnaire template: https://internal.redwood/sec-templates/pci-poc-checklist (scan queued).
Maya S: Next steps: Alex+Priya pair on shim by EOD tomorrow, Devon drafts Azure AD/KMS integration note, Jordan drafts POC pricing options. I'll assemble presales deck for Friday kickoff.
Alex P: Ack. I'll put a minimal shim template in the sales drive and tag @Maya S. :thumbsup:
